L3.1.quote: Thus, once the cutting is done and produces the multiset $A$, the quantity Liu Bang can guarantee from that position is exactly $\tfrac{1+D(A)}{2}$, and Xiang Yu can prevent more.
L3.1.note: Lemma 2 rigorously proves the odd-ranked-sum value under optimal claiming.

L3.2.quote:
The final multiset is therefore (equal pairs) $\uplus\,L$, and by Lemma 1,
$$D(A)=D(L)\le\Sigma(L)=\Delta\le u. \qquad\blacksquare$$
L3.2.note: Subset-sum pigeonhole and an explicit overlay construction work for every Liu division.

L3.3.quote:
For each edge $P_i\in E_T$ the two signs are opposite, so the corresponding term has absolute value $|a_{2i-1}-a_{2i}|=\varepsilon_i$. Hence, using (4.1),
$$u\le|\Xi|\le\sum_{P_i\in E_T}\varepsilon_i+[M\text{ odd}]\,a_M\le D(A).$$
L3.3.note: The tree-component signed-sum argument handles every refinement using at most n cuts.

parsed.notes: Both universal obligations are fully proved for all positive integers n; the reduction and stated closed form are also correct.
